title: Polynomial binary output with a space bound
statement: For every $C,e\in\mathbb{N}$, there exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every input $x$, $M$ outputs the binary representation of $C(|x|+1)^e$, with bits listed from least significant to most significant, within $c(|x|+1)^{e+1}$ steps. For every $x$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the total work space used through step $t$ is at most $c\bigl(C(|x|+1)^e+1\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: C and e are natural numbers
a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine and natural constant exist
output is the binary bit list of C(|x|+1)^e
